## Summary

Describe the observed behavior and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Include a minimal TypeScript example, SDK commit/tag, DoMoCode commit/tag, Node/browser
version, and the relevant route or event type. Redact bearer tokens, API keys, prompts, paths,
and session data.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] The issue does not include credentials or private transcript data.
